title: Vision Detection Generator
source_docs: Automated Driving Toolbox/Driving Scenario and Sensor Modeling/Vision_Detection_Generator.md
text: 在驾驶场景或 RoadRunner Scenario 中根据视觉测量检测目标和车道，输入 2 路、输出 2 路；按 {Length of actors cuboids (m)} 指定长方体长度；{Unique identifier of sensor} 指定唯一传感器标识符、{Types of detections generated by sensor} 指定检测类型 Objects、{Required interval between sensor updates (s)} 指定所需时间间隔、{Required interval between lane detections updates (s)} 指定车道检测更新之间的时间间隔、{Sensor’s (x,y) position (m)} 指定视觉传感器中心的位置、{Sensor’s height (m)} 指定视觉传感器高于地平面的高度、{Yaw angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定传感器的偏航角、{Pitch angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定传感器的俯仰角、{Roll angle of sensor mounted on ego vehicle (deg)} 指定传感器的横滚角、{Source of object bus name} 指定目标总线名称来源、{Source of output lane bus name} 指定车道总线名称的来源、{Object bus name} 指定对象总线名称 valid bus name、{Specify an output lane bus name} 输出车道总线名称 valid bus name、{Maximum number of reported detections} 指定报告的最大检测数、{Maximum number of reported lanes} 指定报告的车道最大数量、{Coordinate system used to report detections} 指定报告的检测的坐标系 Ego、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted、{Maximum detection range (m)} 指定最大检测范围、{Bounding box accuracy (pixels)} 指定边界框准确度、{Smoothing filter noise intensity (m/s^2)} 用于对位置和速度测量进行滤波的噪声强度、{Maximum detectable object speed (m/s)} 指定最大可检测对象速度、{Maximum allowed occlusion for detector} 指定检测器允许的最大遮挡、{Minimum detectable image size of an object} 指定对象的最小高度和宽度、{Probability of detecting a target} 指定检测概率、{Number of false positives per image} 指定视觉传感器每幅图像生成的误检测数、{Minimum lane size in image (pixels)} 指定车道的最大尺寸、{Accuracy of lane boundary (pixels)} 指定车道边界准确度、{Add noise to measurements} 启用向视觉传感器测量值添加噪声、{Select method to specify initial seed} 指定随机数生成器种子的方法、{Initial seed} 指定随机数生成器种子、{Select method to specify actor profiles} 指定参与者配置文件的方法 From Scenario Reader、{MATLAB expression for actor profiles}、{Unique identifier for actors} 指定场景定义的目标物标识符、{User-defined integer to classify actors} 指定用户定义的分类标识符、{Width of actors cuboids (m)} 指定长方体宽度、{Height of actors cuboids (m)} 指定长方体高度、{Rotational center of actors from bottom center (m)} 指定 actor 的旋转中心、{Focal length (pixels)} 指定相机焦距、{Optical center of the camera (pixels)} 指定相机光心、{Image size produced by the camera (pixels)} 指定相机生成的图像大小、{Radial distortion coefficients} 指定径向畸变系数、{Tangential distortion coefficients} 指定切向畸变系数、{Skew of the camera axes} 指定相机轴的斜切角，按实例取值。
